Hi! I am Malvya, a 5th year PhD candidate in Anthropology from Hyderabad (metropolitan city in Southern India). Prior to embarking on my PhD, I was an international development practitioner working with grassroots research/implementation firms, international donor organizations and governments across India and Africa. I hold a background in public policy, development studies and journalism.

My dissertation focuses on how marginalized women navigate aspirations for a "good life" within the constraints of caste, class and informal labor in Hyderabad's urban settlements. I am passionate about global south collaborations, feminist and community based participatory research, program evaluation and translating theory and research findings into real life applications. Please write to me at malvyac@uoregon.edu to get in touch.
